title: Sequence order and sensory-context interactions

titles: Visual cortical sequence filtering with holographic perturbation and matched sensory context

scientific_question: Does sequence order interact with visual context beyond independent visual and optogenetic effects?
primary_outputs: Prespecified interaction contrasts and held-out additive-versus-interaction model predictions.

data_manifest.file_count_scope: Top-level published assets, including code/docs where packaged together; not a participant count.

recording_contract.neural: figure2_data.npz includes panelBC_F_abc and F_cba documented as 257 cells × 50 trials × 200 frames, plus six-experiment traces for other panels. Figure3 includes full traces and also cell × time condition summaries; those summaries are not independent trials.
recording_contract.labels: Stimulated/nonstimulated indices, spatial patterns, trial-order keys and ABC/CBA order. Figure3 sources distinguish visual-only, opto-only and matched/unmatched visual-plus-opto conditions.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Known frame indices and analysis windows in source; exact per-experiment frame-time/stimulation-onset contract has not been verified. Do not convert arbitrary frame indices into milliseconds or infer cross-experiment synchronization.

recording_contract.evidence: 7.37 GB archive central directory (14 entries), full README, Figure2/3 notebook source and helper inspected by small ranges. Input arrays were not downloaded.
